_: The starter skills the videos show: the twelve in skills/starter.json (the pinned set the installer copies into a new Hub), in its order, each with a short line taken from its own description there. tests/video-sources.test.js checks the names match.

skills.name: handoff
skills.line: Closes a session into a note the next one picks up.

skills.name: file-organizer
skills.line: Sorts Downloads and the Inbox into zones. Never deletes.

skills.name: claude-md-doctor
skills.line: Keeps each CLAUDE.md short and checkable.

skills.name: systems-map
skills.line: Maps a project's parts and what depends on what.

skills.name: backlog
skills.line: One place for the work you have not done yet.

skills.name: work-orders
skills.line: Works through the backlog, one order at a time.

skills.name: quick-design
skills.line: A short plan before a change.

skills.name: scope-check
skills.line: Checks the work matched the plan.

skills.name: smoke-check
skills.line: A two-minute "is it still working?" before you merge.

skills.name: notetaker
skills.line: Notes every future session can find.

skills.name: quick-research
skills.line: Answers a question with sources, in one sitting.

skills.name: prompt-coach
skills.line: Teaches you to ask Claude for things well.
